description: This PHP source file defines the LocationService class within the OrangeHRM project. The class provides methods for managing location data, including retrieving, searching, saving, deleting locations, and obtaining related information such as employee count per location and accessible location lists for users. It interacts with Data Access Object (DAO) for persistence and uses several traits for additional functionalities.

classes.name: LocationService
classes.description: This class manages location-related operations within the OrangeHRM system, including retrieval, search, creation, deletion, and access control for location data.

methods.name: getLocationDao
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton instance of LocationDao, instantiating it if necessary.

methods.name: setLocationDao
methods.description: Sets the LocationDao instance for the service.

methods.name: getLocationById
methods.description: Fetches a Location entity by its identifier.

methods.name: searchLocations
methods.description: Performs a search for locations based on given filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchLocationListCount
methods.description: Returns the count of locations matching search criteria.

methods.name: getNumberOfEmployeesForLocation
methods.description: Returns the number of employees associated with a specific location.

methods.name: getLocationIdsForEmployees
methods.description: Retrieves location IDs for a list of employee numbers.

methods.name: getAccessibleLocationsArray
methods.description: Generates an array of locations accessible to a user, optionally filtered by employee number.

methods.name: saveLocation
methods.description: Saves a Location entity to the database.

methods.name: deleteLocations
methods.description: Flags locations as deleted based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getLocationsArray
methods.description: Retrieves all locations and normalizes them into an array.
